description: This source file provides functions for getting and setting email notification security settings within the Utopia framework. It includes two main functions: Utopia_GetEmailNotificationSetting for retrieving current settings, and Utopia_SetEmailNotificationSetting for updating settings. The file manages various email notification parameters such as enabled state, recipient address, server, username, password, and specific breach notification flags.

methods.name: int Utopia_GetEmailNotificationSetting(UtopiaContext * ctx,email_notification_t * pSetting)
methods.description: Retrieves email notification settings from the Utopia context, populating the provided email_notification_t structure with current configuration values.

methods.name: int Utopia_SetEmailNotificationSetting(UtopiaContext * ctx,const email_notification_t * pSetting)
methods.description: Updates email notification settings in the Utopia context based on the values provided in the email_notification_t structure.
